# Calendar contract fixtures

Every fixture is **synthetic, from probe evidence**, never a capture or private export. Source: the phase-2 `probe-evidence.md` runs 1–5 (especially W1–W8, runs 3/4 and Run 5 moved-override selection), interpreted under OWNER DECISIONS OD1–OD10. List/search query windows use a31-day moved-override pad on each side; zoned/UTC results are filtered by requested instants and DATE/floating results by their synthetic-UTC values against the requested range widened24h. Windows zone names are passed through as unrecognized, without a mapping or UTC/offset extras. Expectations are hand-written, not production-helper outputs. No recurrence oracle or dependency is used.

| --- | --- |
| time-forms | Synthetic, from probe evidence W1 DATE pseudo-UTC RID, W2 floating pseudo-UTC RID, W3 TZID-local endpoint/true-UTC RID, W4 stripped TZID; run 4 repeated 01:30/01:30 with RID 06:30Z, explicit UTC second-fold control. Windows/unknown TZID, stored gap and stray DATE TZID are deliberately defensive unmeasured cases, not claims about iCloud. Exact labels, all four warnings, no RID/embedded-rule cross-check. No logical filter range (pure parsing). |
| provider-authority | Synthetic, from probe evidence W6 Feb-29→Feb-28 clamping; W8 equal DATE end and RANGE affecting only named occurrence. RANGE dates/text illustrative. Wide ranges contain all supplied instances; no locally synthesized instances, oracle comparisons forbidden. Public equal endpoint is not rewritten. |

No claim narrow iCloud queries select moved-in instances; omitted upstream instances remain omitted. |

Duplicate ATTACH/parameters, override raw RID and VALARM exclusion are defensive variants. R1 metadata omits URI/base64; all download_supported false. No range (original whole resource). |

Minimal required element markup 135 bytes proves conservative 64-byte bound. |
| icloud-expanded-shape | Synthetic, from an end-to-end run against iCloud: expanded VCALENDAR has no VERSION/PRODID (23 of 25 sampled resources had no VCALENDAR property at all; recurring series carried only X-EXPANDED, X-MASTER-DTSTART, X-MASTER-RRULE). LF line endings, trailing newline. Invented content in the measured shape: a timed TZID event, a nested-VALARM event with X-APPLE-STRUCTURED-LOCATION/TRAVEL parameters, a recurring expansion with `X-RECURRENCE-MASTER`, an all-day event, and attendees/organizer with a folded escaped non-ASCII DESCRIPTION. Covered by `tests/calendar-icloud-shape.test.ts`. No range. |

Covered by `tests/calendar-icloud-shape.test.ts` and `tests/calendar-read.test.ts`. No range. |

## Known-failing contracts

The four `calendar-contract-*.test.ts` files use `pending = process.env['T0_RED'] === '1' ? test : test.failing`. Default validation treats expected failures as known failures, and an unexpected success is a hard failure. Implementers convert a completed case from `pending(...)` to `test(...)` without changing its expectation; after a whole file is implemented remove its alias. `T0_RED=1 bun test tests/calendar-contract-*.test.ts` runs the same assertions as ordinary red tests to verify failure provenance. Implemented P0 regression anchors use ordinary `test`; the Run5 transport-window correction is deliberately known-failing against P0's current24h builder.

Time independence uses explicit UTC/offset fixtures and one child Bun process with `TZ=Pacific/Honolulu`; no test reads the process-local Date calendar. Child wall-clock limits deliberately use real OS process timeouts because fake time cannot bound a stuck child; orchestration budget tests inject clocks/held promises instead of sleeping.
